evidence: All 9 products on /products expose category badge, price, name, brief description, star rating value, image (unsplash src), and a "Buy Now" link to an external retailer URL.

"SONY"→1 product (sony-wh-1000xm5, name match, uppercase); "liquid retina"→1 product (macbook-pro-14, brief-description match); "FLAGSHIP"→1 product (samsung-galaxy-s24-ultra, tag-only match, uppercase). Counts accurate in all cases.

issue: Price-range filter is not a working range control: only one slider thumb is rendered, minimum price can never be set
actual: All four sorts work correctly (newest; rating 4.9→4.4; price-asc $199→$2,495; price-desc $2,495→$199) and the minimum-rating filter works (4.5+ → 8 products, all ≥4.5). However the price slider [data-semtag-id='filters.price'] contains exactly ONE [role=slider] thumb (aria-label="Minimum", aria-valuenow permanently 0) although it is bound to two states (filters.price-min, filters.price-max). Dragging that single "Minimum" thumb changes the MAXIMUM instead (max label went $2495→$2410→$1250, count 9→8→6, correctly filtering ≤ max). The minimum price stays $0 and there is no second thumb to grab, and keyboard (ArrowRight/End) does not move the thumb at all. So visitors cannot filter by a price range, only by a maximum price.

evidence: Typing in search (9→1), changing category, changing sort (order re-ordered), min-rating (9→8) and dragging price max (9→8→6) all updated the grid, order and the "N products found" count live on /products with no page reload.

/products category select: Tech Gadgets → "3 products found" (samsung, macbook, sony, all badged Tech); Home Goods → 3 (breville, philips-hue, dyson, all Home); Fitness → 3 (bowflex, theragun, peloton, all Fitness). Grid and count update together.
All 9 seeded products carry exactly one category badge, drawn only from Tech/Home/Fitness (3 per category; 3+3+3=9 = total count). Homepage category cards also report 3 products each.

Tags apple+vacuum → 2 results (macbook has apple, dyson has vacuum) = OR within tags. Adding category=Tech narrowed to 1 (macbook only) = AND across criteria. Adding search "sony" on top → "0 products found" (no unrelated results). Price max $1250 earlier returned only the 6 products ≤ $1250; min-rating 4.5 returned only products ≥ 4.5.

Detail-page "Buy Now" (product.buy) has href https://example.com/dyson-v15 target=_blank rel; clicking it opened a new browser tab on that external URL. Every card/detail buy action carries its own product-specific external URL (sony-xm5, macbook-pro, s24-ultra, dyson-v15, philips-hue, breville, peloton, theragun, bowflex). Note: seed data uses example.com placeholder domains rather than a real retailer.

Dyson V15 Detect identical across views — homepage latest-home ($749), products grid (Home, $749, 4.7, "Intelligent cordless vacuum with laser dust detection and real-time particle counting."), category view, and detail page (Home, $749, 4.7, same brief description). Detail review renders in full (424 chars, computed line-clamp:none, scrollHeight 104 == clientHeight 104, no ellipsis) and all 5 specs are listed.

Clicking the name link products.grid.item.dyson-v15-detect navigated to /product/dyson-v15-detect showing product.name "Dyson V15 Detect". Clicking the card IMAGE for Bowflex navigated to /product/bowflex-selecttech-552 with product.name "Bowflex SelectTech 552". Each card image is wrapped in an anchor to its own /product/<slug>.

issue: Category select on the category page is inert — choosing a different category changes neither the active category nor the displayed products
actual: On /category/fitness a category filter (filters.category) is offered with all four options (All Categories, Tech Gadgets, Home Goods, Fitness) and shows "Fitness". Selecting "Home Goods" produced no change: URL stayed /category/fitness, h1 and category.name stayed "Fitness", the select trigger still displayed "Fitness", and the grid still showed the same 3 fitness products (bowflex-selecttech-552, theragun-pro, peloton-bike-plus). Repeating with "Tech Gadgets" gave the identical no-op result. (The same control works correctly on /products, and the header nav category links do navigate, so the defect is specific to the category-page select.)

evidence: /product/nonexistent-widget-xyz → "Product Not Found — The product you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed." with a Browse All Products link, no product.name element and 0 images. /category/bogus-category → "Category Not Found — The category you're looking for doesn't exist." with an empty grid. Neither leaks unrelated product data.

issue: Publish validation only enforces name, description and rating range; review, image, retailer link and specs are all optional, and negative prices are accepted
actual: Created "QA Minimal Product" supplying ONLY name + short description. It saved with no error, closed the form, and went live: /products now shows "10 products found" with a card whose is empty and whose "Buy Now" href is empty (dead link). No full review and zero specifications were required. Separately, editing it to price=-50 saved successfully and the admin list renders "-$50"; the price input has no min attribute. The affiliate link field is type=text with no URL validation and accepted the value "not-a-valid-url". Only the rating field is properly constrained (min=0/max=5 blocked the value 9 with "Value must be less than or equal to 5.").

issue: Admin product additions/edits are in-memory only and are lost on any page reload or revisit
actual: Created "Hydrow Wave Rower" via the admin panel; it appeared immediately in the admin list (id mtc7u55jbft177545c) and the product count rose to 10. After reloading (navigating to http://localhost:7001/product/hydrow-wave-rower) the page rendered "Product Not Found", and /products reverted to "9 products found" with no Hydrow entry. localStorage and sessionStorage are both completely empty (0 keys), confirming nothing is persisted — every create/edit/delete reverts to the seeded 9 products on reload.

evidence: Admin category control is a single-select with exactly the three supported options (tech/home/fitness). Created "Hydrow Wave Rower" with category=Fitness; it then appeared in /category/fitness grid (4 items incl. hydrow-wave-rower) and its detail page shows exactly one category badge, "Fitness".

Audited all 10 detail pages (9 seeded + 1 created). Each shows name, exactly one category badge, rating, formatted price, brief description, full review (408–508 chars, none clamped: scrollHeight == clientHeight), 4 tags (3 for the created one), 5 key specifications (3 for the created one), an image with a src, and a Buy Now action with a product-specific external href.

Seeded tags are topically apt and match their category: Sony=headphones/wireless/noise-cancelling/premium (Tech), MacBook=laptop/apple/professional/portable (Tech), Samsung=smartphone/android/camera/flagship (Tech), Dyson=vacuum/cordless/smart-home/cleaning (Home), Philips Hue=lighting/smart-home/ambiance/automation (Home), Breville=coffee/espresso/kitchen/appliance (Home), Peloton=cardio/cycling/smart-equipment/subscription (Fitness), Theragun=recovery/massage/muscle/therapy (Fitness), Bowflex=weights/dumbbells/strength/home-gym (Fitness). Category badge, price and rating on each detail page match the values shown on the homepage, /products grid and category grid.

Created "Hydrow Wave Rower" with three brand-new comma-separated tag values "rowing, qamarker, low-impact". Its detail page renders exactly those three tags (product.tags.item.rowing / .qamarker / .low-impact). Keyword search for "QAMARKER" on /products returns "1 product found" = hydrow-wave-rower, so the new tags participate in keyword search.

issue: Homepage featured strip is hard-capped at 3 and the "View all" featured link ignores the featured filter, so the complete set of featured products cannot be browsed
actual: Marking works: after creating "Hydrow Wave Rower" with featured=on it got a "Featured" badge, and after unmarking Dyson in admin the homepage strip changed from [sony, peloton, dyson] to [sony, peloton, hydrow] — so marking/unmarking does update the collection. BUT with 4 products featured (sony, peloton, dyson, hydrow) the homepage strip rendered only 3 and hydrow was omitted with no way to reach it. The strip's "View all" link points to /products?featured=true, and that page ignores the featured query parameter entirely: it rendered "10 products found" listing every product including non-featured ones (macbook, theragun, philips-hue, breville, bowflex, samsung), and the heading stayed "All Products". There is no working view of the complete featured set.

evidence: Edited Dyson V15 Detect tags from "vacuum, cordless, smart-home, cleaning" to "vacuum, cordless-stick, smart-home, qafresh" — one add (qafresh), one rename (cordless→cordless-stick), one removal (cleaning). Detail page now lists exactly vacuum / cordless-stick / smart-home / qafresh. Keyword search "qafresh" → "1 product found" = dyson-v15-detect; search "cleaning" → "0 products found", confirming the removed tag no longer matches.

issue: Tag-filter choice list is a static hard-coded set that never reflects tags assigned to products
actual: Assigned the new tag "qafresh" (plus renamed "cordless"→"cordless-stick") to the existing product Dyson V15 Detect, and created a product with new tags "rowing, qamarker, low-impact". The saved tags are on the products (Dyson detail page lists qafresh; keyword search "qafresh" finds it). But the /products advanced tag filter still lists exactly the same 35 original tags: none of cordless-stick, qafresh, rowing, qamarker or low-impact is offered as a filter choice, so the new tag cannot be selected at all. Conversely the removed tags "cleaning" and "cordless" are still offered, and selecting "cleaning" yields "0 products found" — a dead filter option.
